§8Purpose and mechanism§r
Keep one T20 Portable Autocannon in your inventory for this non-consuming check. The T20 is an MV assembler weapon using §120§r mm ammo packs. Standard mode delivers direct fire, while airburst mode detonates near entities. Default controls: C changes mode, V changes ammunition, and R reloads. Left-click fires and right-click aims. Key bindings can be changed in settings.

§3Preparation and operation§r
The recipe uses aluminium plates, long steel rods, MV motors and a piston, MV circuits, and an integrated circuit set to §12.§r Modes change the attack behavior; select one for the target position and consider nearby entities. Possession completes the goal without firing. Check the §120§r mm pack and key bindings beforehand; other calibers are not interchangeable supplies.
